title: Fett’s Blast of Death
front_description: Mace Windu signals, and at strategic places around the execution arena there are sudden flashes of light as about one hundred Jedi switch on their lightsabers! "Brave, but very foolish, my old Jedi friend," comments Dooku, faintly amused by this challenge. "You're impossibly outnumbered." Jango Fett suddenly fires his flame-thrower at Windus igniting the Jedi's robe.
back_description: Samuel L. Jackson holds his fellow actors at bay with his lightsaber prop.
